title: Sovereign Artifact Runtime (SAR) Schema
description: Schema validating dynamic self-hosted artifact workspaces (Claude Code style) compiled for browser rendering.

content.description: The raw payload content (HTML, dynamic ArrowJS code, or markdown text) to mount inside the sandbox.

dependencies.description: External JS libraries or styling CDN files required (e.g. lucide, tailwind, d3).

designTokens.description: Custom color palettes, font settings, or layouts to apply to the rendered artifact.
